record.paper_title: Symmetric Functions in Superspace: A Compendium of Results and Open Problems (Including a SageMath Worksheet)
record.context_brief: Combinatorial formula for Jack superpolynomial integral-form coefficients
record.original_question: Find a combinatorial description for the coefficients v_{ΛΩ}(α) in the monomial expansion J_Λ^(α)=Σ_{Ω≤Λ} v_{ΛΩ}(α)m_Ω of the integral-form Jack superpolynomials, analogous to the known combinatorial description in the ordinary Jack-polynomial case cited as [31].

evidence.quote: We define the integral form of the Jack superpolynomials, to be denoted J^(α)_Λ, as (3.38) J^(α)_Λ = v_Λ(α)P^(α)_Λ,
When expanded in the monomial basis, i.e. (3.39) J^(α)_Λ = ∑_{Ω≤Λ} v_{ΛΩ}(α) m_Ω,
Open problem 3.2 – Find a combinatorial description, analogous to that of [31], for the expansion coefficients v_{ΛΩ}(α) in (3.39).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and setup. Work in the ring of symmetric functions in superspace, i.e. polynomials in commuting variables x_1,x_2,... and anticommuting variables θ_1,θ_2,... that are invariant under the simultaneous diagonal action of the symmetric group on the indices. A superpartition Λ of bi-degree (n|m) is a pair (Λ^a;Λ^s), where Λ^a=(Λ_1,...,Λ_m) is a strict partition (possibly containing a final 0) of fermionic length m, and Λ^s is an ordinary partition; together they encode a partition of n with a distinguished subset of m parts.

For each superpartition Λ, let m_Λ denote the monomial symmetric function in superspace indexed by Λ, defined by symmetrizing θ_1···θ_m x_1^{Λ_1}···x_m^{Λ_m} (x_{m+1}^{Λ^s_1} x_{m+2}^{Λ^s_2}···) over the diagonal symmetric group action. Equip the set of superpartitions of fixed bi-degree (n|m) with the dominance order ≤.

There is a unique family {P_Λ^{(α)}} of Jack symmetric functions in superspace, indexed by superpartitions, such that
   P_Λ^{(α)} = m_Λ + Σ_{Ω<Λ} c_{ΛΩ}(α) m_Ω,
and {P_Λ^{(α)}} are mutually orthogonal with respect to the deformed scalar product on superspace (the natural one-parameter family generalizing the Macdonald inner product to superspace). The integral-form Jack superpolynomials are defined by
   J_Λ^{(α)} = v_Λ(α) P_Λ^{(α)},
where v_Λ(α) is the explicit polynomial in α normalizing P_Λ^{(α)} so that, when expanded in the monomial basis,
   J_Λ^{(α)} = Σ_{Ω≤Λ} v_{ΛΩ}(α) m_Ω,
the coefficients v_{ΛΩ}(α) are polynomials in α with non-negative integer coefficients (this positivity/integrality is observed conjecturally in this superspace setting and is the analogue of the classical Knop–Sahi result).

Problem. Provide an explicit combinatorial description of the coefficients v_{ΛΩ}(α) appearing in the monomial expansion
   J_Λ^{(α)} = Σ_{Ω≤Λ} v_{ΛΩ}(α) m_Ω
of the integral-form Jack superpolynomials. The description should be analogous to the classical Knop–Sahi combinatorial formula expressing the integral-form Jack polynomial coefficients as a sum over admissible (non-attacking) tableaux/fillings of the corresponding Young diagram, weighted by products of hook-type statistics in α; here it should be expressed as a weighted sum over a suitable combinatorial set of fillings of the diagram associated to the superpartition Λ.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a published combinatorial Knop–Sahi-type formula for the monomial expansion coefficients v_{ΛΩ}(α) of integral-form Jack superpolynomials. Related work continues on Jack polynomials in superspace and on positive combinatorial formulas for ordinary Jack polynomials, but no explicit superspace analogue appears to be established. Status remains unverified.

status_evidence.title: Jack Polynomials in Superspace
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces and studies Jack polynomials in superspace; combinatorial monomial-expansion coefficients are described as rational functions in the parameter, with no Knop–Sahi-type formula given.
status_evidence.claim: The supersymmetric Jack theory is developed but a combinatorial monomial expansion analogous to Knop–Sahi is not provided.

status_evidence.title: A Recursion and a Combinatorial Formula for Jack Polynomials (Knop–Sahi)
status_evidence.snippet: Provides the classical combinatorial formula for the monomial expansion coefficients of integral-form Jack polynomials via admissible tableaux.
status_evidence.claim: This is the classical (non-super) result whose superspace analogue is being asked for.
